Stitch gives us the foundation to issue, control, scale, and trust at a level where geography isn’t the limitation.” Kashif Khan Founder & CEO Pre-built connectors to the providers you already use What Is Stitch? Stitch is the operating system that enables banks, fintechs, and non-financial companies to build, launch, and scale financial products from a single platform. Rather than stitching together separate vendors for cards, lending, wallets, deposits, and payments, Stitch consolidates everything into one AI-native platform. The result: faster time to market, lower total cost of ownership, and the flexibility to launch new products without rebuilding your technology stack. Whether you are a bank modernizing legacy systems, a fintech scaling a new product line, or a non-financial company embedding finance into your platform, Stitch provides the infrastructure layer that makes it possible. Stitch is trusted by companies across multiple continents to power mission-critical financial products serving millions of end users. Stitch's platform spans six core product domains, all accessible through a single integration: cards (launch and manage prepaid, debit, and credit card programs), lending (originate, underwrite, disburse, service, and collect on any loan product), wallets (deploy digital wallets with P2P transfers, bill payments, and multi-currency balances), deposits (configure savings accounts, term deposits, and demand deposit products), payments (process transactions across cards, bank transfers, and wallets through a unified payment switch), and ledgers (maintain accurate, auditable financial records with a programmable double-entry ledger). Each module works independently or together, so you can start with one product and expand over time without switching platforms. Stitch is a unified platform that helps financial institutions build, manage, and scale financial products, such as ledgers, cards, lending, deposits, and more. Who can benefit from using Stitch? Stitch is designed for any regulated institution including banks, lenders, and other financial service providers looking to build a financial product or enhance their operations. Soon, Stitch will be accessible to unregulated institutions as well. How does Stitch support financial product development? Stitch provides a comprehensive suite of tools for creating, managing, and scaling financial products with seamless integrations and secure infrastructure. Is Stitch scalable? Yes, Stitch is built to scale with your business, ensuring smooth operations and the ability to handle high transaction volumes and complex processes. How secure is the Stitch platform? Stitch follows industry-leading security protocols to ensure the safety and integrity of your data and financial transactions at all times.
